name: Atelier
css: .popover, .popover.sheet { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(22% 0.015 250 / 0.12), inset 0 0 0 6px var(--docent-bg), inset 0 0 0 7px oklch(22% 0.015 250 / 0.14), var(--docent-shadow); } .title { font-family: Didot, 'Bodoni 72', 'Iowan Old Style', ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .eyebrow, .count { font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0.01em; font-size: 13px; } .footer { margin-top: 22px; } .button { border-radius: 0; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .button.primary { padding-inline: 18px; }
